report.summary: Patient P-D006 (age 59, uninsured/self-pay, no transport benefit, home tract 17031290900) has medication-cost and transport needs. Medication barriers: brand tiotropium inhaler costs $420/month with a 45-day refill gap, and albuterol has a 10-day gap, indicating cost-related nonadherence. For med_cost, the Clinic Rx Fund (current-patient copay help) and Community Pharmacy Assistance (Extra Help/manufacturer program applications) appear potentially eligible; Rx Bridge Program (chronic illness) may also apply. For transport, Senior Shuttle West requires age 60+, so the 59-year-old patient is not eligible; Medicaid Ride Line requires Medicaid membership, so not eligible as uninsured. Paratransit Info Desk (ADA certification, apply by phone, up to 21-day decision) is the best transport option to pursue. The patient's next scheduled visit is appt:2 (primary care, Clinic, 2026-10-23 14:00).
